en.heading: Download a TikTok video as MP4
en.intro: Paste the link of a public TikTok video and VidFetch lists the MP4 renditions TikTok publishes for that post, with their resolution. Pick one and the file is saved to your phone or computer. Nothing to install, no account, no sign-in.
instructions: In the TikTok app, tap Share and then Copy link. On a computer, copy the address of the video page.
Paste the link in the field above and select Extract. A short automatic verification may run before the first download.
Keep the Video tab, choose a resolution and select Download. Keep the page open until the transfer finishes.
supported: Video pages such as https://www.tiktok.com/@creator/video/7059698374567611694
Short links from the app share menu: vm.tiktok.com, vt.tiktok.com and tiktok.com/t/…
A whole share message pasted from the app: the link inside it is used
MP4 video, or MP3 audio from the Audio tab
limits: Only public videos open: private accounts, friends-only posts and deleted videos cannot be downloaded.
Photo posts (slideshows), profiles, hashtags and live streams are not supported.
VidFetch saves a rendition TikTok publishes and does not edit the image, so it cannot remove a watermark that is part of the video.
Each connection can make up to 8 downloads per day, and the service shares a daily capacity between all users.

faqs.question: Can I download a TikTok video without a watermark?
faqs.answer: Only if TikTok publishes such a rendition for that post. VidFetch lists the formats TikTok returns and saves the one you pick unchanged; it does not crop, blur or re-encode the image to hide a watermark.

faqs.question: Do links copied from the TikTok app work?
faqs.answer: Yes. Short links such as vm.tiktok.com or tiktok.com/t/ are accepted, and you can paste the full share message: VidFetch finds the link inside it.

faqs.question: Why does a TikTok link fail?
faqs.answer: The most common reasons are a private or deleted video, a region restriction, a photo post, or an expired short link. VidFetch shows the reason instead of producing an empty file.

faqs.question: Is there a limit?
faqs.answer: Files up to 256 MB, videos up to 30 minutes, one preparation at a time, and up to 8 downloads per day for each connection.

Les liens courts du menu Partager : vm.tiktok.com, vt.tiktok.com et tiktok.com/t/…

faqs.question: Peut-on télécharger une vidéo TikTok sans filigrane ?
faqs.answer: Seulement si TikTok publie une telle version pour cette vidéo. VidFetch liste les formats renvoyés par TikTok et enregistre celui que vous choisissez tel quel ; il ne recadre ni ne floute l'image pour masquer un filigrane.

faqs.question: Les liens copiés depuis l'application fonctionnent-ils ?
faqs.answer: Oui. Les liens courts vm.tiktok.com ou tiktok.com/t/ sont acceptés, et vous pouvez coller tout le message de partage : VidFetch y retrouve le lien.

faqs.question: Pourquoi un lien TikTok échoue-t-il ?
faqs.answer: Le plus souvent : vidéo privée ou supprimée, restriction géographique, publication photo ou lien court expiré. VidFetch indique la raison au lieu de produire un fichier vide.

faqs.question: Y a-t-il une limite ?
faqs.answer: Fichiers jusqu'à 256 Mo, vidéos jusqu'à 30 minutes, une préparation à la fois, et jusqu'à 8 téléchargements par jour pour chaque connexion.

en.title: TikTok to MP3 – Save a TikTok Sound
en.description: Turn the sound of a public TikTok video into a real MP3 file (192 kbps). Paste the link, open the Audio tab and save it. Free and no account needed.
en.heading: Convert a TikTok video to MP3
en.intro: Want the voice-over, a talk or the music of a TikTok you are allowed to keep? Paste the link of the public video, open the Audio tab and VidFetch encodes its soundtrack into a genuine MP3 file at 192 kbps, ready for any player.
instructions: Copy the link of the TikTok video: Share, then Copy link in the app, or the page address on a computer.
Paste it in the field above and select Extract.
Open the Audio tab, choose MP3 and select Download. Keep the page open until the file is saved.
supported: Any public TikTok video link, including vm.tiktok.com and tiktok.com/t/ short links
MP3 encoded with ffmpeg at 192 kbps from the video's soundtrack
Videos up to 30 minutes
limits: The MP3 comes from a specific video: TikTok sound pages (/music/…) and playlists are not supported.
The audio is converted from the soundtrack TikTok serves; it cannot be better than that source.
Music in a video may be protected by copyright: only keep audio you have the right to use.

faqs.question: Is the file a real MP3?
faqs.answer: Yes. The soundtrack is decoded and re-encoded with ffmpeg as an MP3 at 192 kbps; it is not a video file renamed to .mp3.

faqs.question: Can I download a sound from its TikTok sound page?
faqs.answer: No. Paste the link of a video that uses the sound instead; VidFetch converts the audio of that video.

faqs.question: Will the MP3 play on my phone or in my car?
faqs.answer: MP3 is supported by practically every phone, computer, car stereo and audio editor, which is why VidFetch uses it for audio downloads.

faqs.question: Does it keep the original quality?
faqs.answer: Yes. Video downloads are not re-encoded: the MP4 keeps the resolution and codec Instagram serves for that Reel.

faqs.question: Can I download Reels from a private account?
faqs.answer: No. VidFetch only opens content that an anonymous visitor can see, and it does not ask for your Instagram login.

faqs.question: Why was a public Reel refused?
faqs.answer: Instagram sometimes blocks automated requests from servers or asks for a sign-in. VidFetch shows that reason; trying again later may work, but it never bypasses the restriction.

faqs.question: ¿Se mantiene la calidad original?
faqs.answer: Sí. Los vídeos no se recomprimen: el MP4 conserva la resolución y el códec que Instagram sirve para esa publicación.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo descargar vídeos de una cuenta privada?
faqs.answer: No. VidFetch solo abre lo que puede ver un visitante sin sesión iniciada y nunca te pide tu contraseña de Instagram.

faqs.question: ¿Por qué se ha rechazado un vídeo público?
faqs.answer: Instagram bloquea a veces las solicitudes automáticas desde servidores o pide iniciar sesión. VidFetch muestra el motivo; volver a intentarlo más tarde puede funcionar, pero nunca se salta la restricción.

faqs.question: Can I keep only the sound of an X video?
